notes.title: Youropa 2.0.10
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32141437/abc5ff78360ee3f215d7c7e510882a0a80387483.png[/img]

Hurray, Youropa is now Steam Deck Verified!

Here is a short list of what's new in the latest update:

- General - Fix for texture seams on characters 
- General - Adjustments to frame timing code
- General - Fixes to some animations not playing at correct speed
- General - Removed some debug 
- General - Graphics/Controls/Audio settings are now saved per device, and is not synced on Steam Cloud.
- Audio - Adjusted music levels, to improve general audio mix
- OpenGL - Fix for several shader issues
- OpenGL - Fix for bad shadow sampling
- Share - Fix for issue with playing levels from Steam Workshop
- Share - Added Subscribe button for each level/character in the browser
- Share - Added Subscribed tab to You section in the browser
- Steam Deck - Support for Frame Limiter. Enable "Variable Frame Rate (Steam Deck)" in Options/Graphics to ensure the game runs at the correct speed, when the Frame Limiter is enabled. It should be enabled by default.
- Steam Deck - Fixes for On Screen Keyboard
- UI - Increased smallest font size
- UI - Improved layout for resolutions above 1920x1080

If you find any bugs, drop me an email at support@frecle.net

Happy Festivus and have a great New Year.

Have fun,
Mikkel

notes.title: Fixes in 2.0.7
notes.content:
Hi,

Here's a brief overview of what's changed in version 2.0.7:
[list]
[*]General - Fix for not loading correct texture after character had been splatted and then designed.
[*]General - Fix for crash when attempting to load preview of a completely empty level.

[*]General - Fix for some keys mapped to multiple things in the character designer.
[*]General - Fix for two statues unlocking the same design.
[*]DirectX - Fix for crash when saving thumbnail of character design (attempt to render from system memory).

[*]OpenGL - Fix for shader compilation on some GPUs (wrong return type).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32141437/4737ffe41971349be134c487aa489f7e4380ee9c.png[/img]

And as always if you find any bugs, drop me an email at support@frecle.net or post in the forums.

Have fun,
Mikkel

notes.title: Super Youropa Update
notes.content:
I'm happy to [b]finally[/b] bring you a new update, packed with features, tweaks, fixes and changes. It's the biggest update ever, with lots of cool improvements. Let's take a quick look...

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
[tr]
[td]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32141437/ff01ce6b3e13b36075bb730c4ee1ab4826a0ff2d.gif[/img]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Create mode lets you build a level while playing it. And you can share it on Steam Workshop directly inside the game.[/b]
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[h2]What's new?[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Create mode[/b] - Build levels while playing them, including a full tutorial.
[*] [b]Share[/b] - Built-in sharing makes it easy to show your friends the levels and characters you've designed.
[*] [b]Improved character designer[/b] - More options and easier to use.
[*] [b]Paintable statues[/b] - Find and paint statues to unlock unique character skins.
[*] [b]More levels[/b] - A new hidden area to find.
[*] [b]Challenge mode[/b] - A new mode to unlock.
[*] [b]Hundreds of smaller bug fixes and adjustments[/b] - Everything from optimizations to coyote time and crash fixes.
[*] [b]Adjustable Refresh Rate[/b] (beta) - Select the framerate that fits your monitor.
[*] [b]OpenGL renderer[/b] (beta) - Might make the game run better on some machines. OpenGL is now the default renderer, add "-driver directx9" to the command line to force the D3D9 renderer.
[*] [b]DirectInput[/b] (beta) - Support for more controllers.
[*] [b]Adjustable Physics Update Rate[/b] (experimental) - Select the physics update rate.
[/list]

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
[tr]
[td]
[b]Sharing a character design from the updated character designer.[/b]
[/td]
[td]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32141437/6f4d45e867e178195960b5c0c3eafe4f8ecb9ec6.gif[/img]
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[h2]Bugs?[/h2]
If you find a bug (very likely) let me know, so I have a chance to fix it. As always, it's easiest if you drop an email at support@frecle.net. I read every email sent, but I might not have time to reply to all of them.

It would be super nice to hear how it plays with [b]mouse and keyboard[/b], and whether it runs well on [b]Steam Deck[/b], or somethings need to be fixed. 

If you have been creating levels in the original editor, there might be some issues carrying that over to the new Creator mode. If you encounter any problems please send me an email, and I'll help you out.

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
[tr]
[td]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32141437/8d904c07922a9a885ff5b2b9402a345a6456cf57.gif[/img]
[/td]
[td]
[b]Painting a statue unlocks special character designs. Can you find them all?[/b]
[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[h2]Switch![/h2]
[url=https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/youropa-switch/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32141437/a5c79ff613d02c2ba4b6d89100c52ea41618bf1c.png[/img][/url]
Youropa was just released for Nintendo Switch. If you'd like to support me, why not get that version too? [url=https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/youropa-switch/ style=button]https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/youropa-switch/[/url]

Until next time, take care & have fun!
[b]Mikkel[/b]

notes.title: Creator Mode - Preview
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32141437/606ed943561c06c0c89afbb5b504bbf335442093.jpg[/img]

We've finally gotten to a point where we'd like you to take the Creator Mode (name is not final) for a spin. If you'd like to try it out, do this:

[h1]Join the preview[/h1]
[list][*] Right click on Youropa in Steam
[*] Select "Properties"
[*] Go to the "BETAS" tab
[*] Select "Beta - " from the dropdown
[*] Steam may need to restart before it downloads the beta version, depending on your settings.[/list]

Once you're in the game go to "Create" mode, and either make a new level or load one you already made. Hit "C" on the keyboard or "LB/L1" on the controller to enter Creator Mode. The rest has onscreen display to help you out.

[h1]Work In Progress!!![/h1]
Slowly we hope Creator Mode will be able to replace the editor completely, but for now there are a number of things that it doesn't do. Here's a quick list of things you should be aware of:
- [b]No auto saving!!![/b] you need to open the editor, select a block and move it for the level to be saved. Auto-saving in Creator Mode is top of the list for the next version.
- [b]No undo!!![/b]
- [b]No styling!!![/b] to adjust time of day, weather etc. you still need to do it from the editor.
- [b]No editing of wires or patrol paths[/b] go to the editor to edit those.
- [b]Some objects change rotation etc. when being created[/b] the preview of what you're about to make is not always accurate.
- [b]UI WIP!!![/b] the object selection is pretty confusing if you're new - we're working on making it much more accessible.
- [b]The game is running while you're editing[/b] so watch out for enemies etc. This may change in the future.
- [b]Overview[/b] going into overview while in creator mode can cause weird stuff .. we aim to make the overview navigate a little like the editor at a later stage, to make it easy to adjust things far from yourself.
- [b]Unlock[/b] some objects won't become accessible until you've completed parts of the main game. 
- [b]Jetpack[/b] to let you get easily around there's a jetpack .. Hold "space" or "A" on controller to go up, the jetpack will let you hover in the air. Tap "space" or "A" to drop down.

[h1]Give us feedback![/h1]
Again please note that this is a preview and some things aren't working and almost everything else will change. But having said that we'd love to get your feedback, so let us know what you like and what you don't like - and be sure to post your cool creations and ideas, to help us make the game better.

We really hope you have fun with the preview!

notes.title: Share Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32141437/918511e8a029ff5b229071196391805fa8dda2e7.png[/img]
The latest update which you can play right now contains a beta version of [b]Level Sharing[/b] via Steam Workshop! 

Try it out by playing a tiny adventure with 4 levels using this ID [b]569CBD27[/b] - Just copy/paste it into the Share popup from the Main Menu.

And get creative and share your own adventures from the Create mode. Open the menu while having your map open by hitting "Esc" and select "Share [BETA]" to start sharing your own city. To share an individual level, hover over it and hit "0" (Zero) on the keyboard to start sharing.

You will need to accept the Steam Workshop agreement before you can access all the sharing features.

We will be smoothing out the experience and adding additional features over the coming weeks, so if there's something specific you'd like to see just let us know.

Here's a list of changes for this update:
[list]
[*]Share - Added simple sharing interface for sharing levels and adventures (BETA)
[*]TouchButton - Fix not triggering when landing on top without leaving trigger area
[*]Soccer Ball - Fix sticking to feet when pulling away
[*]Map Editor - Added settings for the map to adjust which powers You start with and how time of day is handled
[*]Editor - Fix for Cassette counter not showing when quick opening Elements menu
[*]Editor - Added animation to elements when placing them
[*]Create Mode - Adjustments to file layouts and more in preparation for level sharing. If your levels break or have gone missing let us know.
[*]Save Game - Separated save games for single player game and create mode in preparation for level sharing. If your save game breaks let us know.
[*]Performance - Improved scene capturing performance by 33% 
[*]Performance - Reduced cloud rendering CPU cost by 45%
[*]Options - Moved all options to separate save file
[*]Editor Unlocks - Moved to separate save file
[/list]

As there have been a good deal of internal restructuring to fully support level sharing, there may be things we have missed during internal testing.
If you find anything isn't working as expected let us know!

Have fun!

notes.title: Update - July 4th
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32141437/ab4d70373abe7a289096d2329e4c3c2836f8b2ac.png[/img]
Time for the first post launch update!

We've been hard at work trying to resolve as many of the issues you've reported, as well as some we have noted from earlier rounds.

The biggest change in this update are camera tweaks which hopefully makes getting around Youropa a nicer experience. We've adjusted some settings, to make the camera a little softer in the way it follows the ground, and adjusted the way input is handled, so you can now tweak how direct your camera input is treated from the options menu. Overall it should help people who have experienced a bit of motion queasiness, and make for a smoother ride for all of you.

We've also tweaked map editing, so you can now connect logic across levels by linking wires on the map, and you can also delete wires and portal connections. For the wires, they will only use the "global input" from another level, if there is no "local input" attached to it on the level itself. Tell us if that doesn't make sense.

Here's a full list of changes to this update:
[list][*]Resolution - Match desktop resolution on first run
[*]Translations - Adjusted Norwegian translations
[*]Translations - Fixed spelling mistake in "Camera Edge Prediction"
[*]Paint / Powerup Platform - Fixed issue when entering platform while carrying an item (invalid state change during physics update)
[*]Umbrella - Fixed collision model
[*]Umbrella - Adjusted animation when carrying
[*]Pogo Stick - Adjusted collision model
[*]Pogo Stick - Adjusted animation when carrying
[*]File Requester - Minimizes game when in full screen, and restores game after being closed
[*]Achievements - Fix for "Loot Box" achievement cheat.
[*]Physics/IK - Fix for NaN issue in soft IK
[*]Wire - Added output
[*]Controls - Mouse look input now matches joypad/keyboard input (Y inverted, so you may need to adjust your control settings)
[*]Editor - Fix for text input not updating
[*]Editor - Fix for switching wire style not updating visuals
[*]Editor - Connecting wires on map also connects level logic. Only wires with no connections internally in the level will use the external input
[*]Editor - Connections can now be deleted on the map
[*]Editor - Fix for color picker closing menu / editor when pressing cancel
[*]Camera - Fix for spin when entering vehicle
[*]Camera - Smoother ground following
[*]Camera - Adjustable input smoothing (missing translations for most languages) see Options/Camera
[*]Camera - Allow overview to shift more
[*]Camera - Minor adjustments during teleportation
[*]Camera - Fix for jitter during transition to overview
[*]Map - Fixed path to next objective not updating correctly when opening map
[*]Map - Minor tutorial fix
[*]Level - Smaller gap between pipe and platform in "Pipes"
[*]Level - Moved bush to prevent you getting stuck in "TinyTower"
[*]Level - More checkpoints on oil levels
[*]Level - More checkpoints on vehicle levels[/list]

Secret news: [spoiler]We've started working on level sharing, so stay tuned for more news about that soon![/spoiler]

As always, if you encounter bugs or feel something could be improved let us know. Ask in the forums or send us an email at support@frecle.net

Have fun!

notes.title: Release Candidate 0
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32141437/9e322ae681f2dcf928ab54958b83dc1de8a68983.png[/img]

Yes, we are nearly there for the release! It's hard to believe it's finally happening - more than 10 years after we started working on Youropa -  but what a great feeling it is!

As always there are a million things we wanted to fix, but not enough time. We've been going over your reports and our own lists, to find out which details should make the cut. It's been some busy days, but we're pretty happy with what we've got. So without further ado, here are the changes in the latest update - which will be the last before release barring some unforseen incident:
[list]
[*]Renderer - Adjusted frame timing decrease stuttering, should result in smoother framerate - if you experience a performance decrease please let us know!
[*]Achievements - Icons added to Steam
[*]Achievements - Corrected the number of cassettes to unlock the K7 achievement from 130 to 139. (Frenchmen will understand why it's K7)
[*]Options - Show all input methods for mouse/keyboard input

[*]Options - Only show options if there is an actual choice to make
[*]Controls - Arrow keys can now be used to control the camera
[*]Vehicle - Fixed not being properly reset after falling out of level
[*]CrumblingBlock - Improved performance
[*]Onesider - Audio/Animation sync fixes
[*]Wires - Animation adjustments
[*]TargetButton - Fix for not returning to upright position after being reset

[*]You - Don't render in Main Menu

[*]You - Fix for turning during Overview if carrying specific objects
[*]You - Fix for look direction during Overview
[*]You - Fix for sidestep animation not playing when on walls / ceilings
[*]You - Suction sound when jumping off wall
[*]You - Fixed issue in collision callback that could cause crash
[*]Dog - Added missing audio to some animations
[*]Crash Barriers - Made physical instead of static
[*]Hedges - Adjusted collision material
[*]Portal - Pushing back while standing in portal activates teleport
[*]Portal - Fixed immediate teleportation when picking something up while standing in portal
[*]Metro Train - Fixed lights pointing in wrong directions
[*]Metro Tracks - Fixed texture tiling
[*]Map - Corrected transition in/out of map
[*]Map - Transition to level during loading
[*]Spot Light - Nicer shadows
[*]Spot Light - Volumetric light fixes
[*]Audio - Adjusted logo sound
[*]Audio - Adjusted day time music
[*]Audio - Adjusted dog biting and snapping
[*]Audio - Hard landing audio adjusted
[*]UI - Fix for incorrect rendering of very slim elements
[*]UI - Minor adjustments to layout and button/tooltips

[*]Translations - Added missing translations to French (thanks Jeremy)[/list]
As always, the fun doesn't stop just because we release, so if you do find bugs or things you think could be improved we would be happy to hear from you. Send us an email at support@frecle.net and we will do our very best to help you out.

Have fun!

notes.title: Beta Update - May 4th
notes.content:
Finally it's time for another beta update - and a BRAND NEW TRAILER!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32141437/08a8ace66095828fd3dd3d4241a6a6e53c8381c5.png[/img]

Check out the trailer on the store page or on [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2_t3XUurm6Q]YouTube[/url]. Let us know if you like it!

And as you can tell from the trailer, we will launch in June. Precise date to be announced soon.

Changes in this Beta include:

[b]Elements Unlockable in Editor[/b]
- It's now possible to unlock elements in the Level Editor. The system is not final, and lacks some feedback but should be working.
- Each unlock costs 1 cassette tape. Cassette tapes are collected during the main game.
- Some unlocks requires you to have certain abilities, indicated by stars inside the lock. If the lock is black, you do not have sufficient abilities to unlock the element.
- Locked elements are grouped, so one unlock can give you more than one element. It is shown below the "Lock" how many parts you will get for unlocking.
[b]- Let us know if this feels fair. It's meant to be fun, not a chore, so if it feels unbalanced please tell us.[/b]

[b]Levels:[/b]
- Intro flow - seperated switch from initial path to lessen confusion.
- Added "The Sewer" level
- Water Garden - Fix for awning issue
- Cams And Boxes - Fix for deadlock when dragging box beyond "waterfall"
- Action Temple - Fix for powerup platform not activating (visually) correctly

[b]Audio:[/b]
- Adjusted overall mix levels
- Danger stinger won't play during Action music
- Environment audio correctly adapts to time of day
- Fixed glitch when entering a level with rain
- Fixed night music and ambience volume
- Added ending to "bridge" audio
- Removed Ghettoblaster from levels with enemies
- Fixed not stopping danger music correctly when leaving play mode

[b]UI & Input:[/b]
- Map is better sorted, and less confusing when lines, levels, etc. overlap.
- Back button shown on map screens
- Improved mouse + keyboard input on map screens
- Editor UI updated and element selection has been streamlined.
- Editor grid changed.
- Editor input for mouse + keyboard slightly improved (we have a bigger change coming, but couldn't finish it for this update).

[b]Rendering:[/b]
- Links between levels (in overview) are softer.
- Background rendering improved.
- Clouds no longer pop due to lighting changes, but fade smoothly.
- Clouds slightly updated.
- Fix for rendering errors on multiple gothic assets.
- Fix for rendering errors on multiple items with cutters (holes, windows, etc)
- Fix for player spine exploding when landing after a fast jump

[b]Crash Fixes:[/b]
- Fix for crash due to uninitialized animation state on player.
- Fix for crash during shutdown (due to incorrect deletion order)
- Fix for editor crash when deleting elements.

[b]Localization:[/b]
- Added German (thanks Daniel) and French (thanks Jeremy) translations.
- Seperated languages into different files.
- Rebuild menus when changing language.
- Fixes to lower/uppercase of language specific letters.

[b]If you speak an amazing language that we don't support yet, and want to help out translating send an email to support@frecle.net[/b]

That's all for this round, more improvements and updates coming soon!

Have a great weekend!

notes.title: Beta Update - April 6th
notes.content:
Yes, it's time for another beta update! This time your disappearing box problems should be fixed along with a ton of other things.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32141437/7eeba390031e098139bd770fb8f4ee695f97355c.png[/img]

Thanks to everyone who send us bug reports and feedback. Keep it coming! If you have specific issues or need to be contacted about your issues, please send a mail straight to support@frecle.net.

Also this week we did a small interview with GameAnalytics about the development of Youropa. You should check it out here:
[url=https://gameanalytics.com/blog/decade-dreaming-frecle-youropa.html]https://gameanalytics.com/blog/decade-dreaming-frecle-youropa.html[/url]

Here's a list of changes:

New Stuff
- Resetter object that can be used to reset physical objects and more (yes, we needed it to fix a few of your issues :) )
- Reset Level menu option to reset a level to it's original state. This shouldn't be needed, but it's there in case we overlooked something.
- Larger Container to fit bigger stuff inside

Level Fixes
- One Box Island fix for deadlock situation
- Rainy City Center End fix for deadlock situation
- Cams And Boxes respawn fix
- Flying Fans fix for deadlock situation
- Elecrtic Pistons fix for possible cheat

Performance Fixes
- Faster startup
- Customization startup time improved (there may still be a slight lag but should < 0.3 seconds)
- Customization performance fixes.

Gameplay Fixes
- Cassette, graffiti and powerup counting should now be stored correctly (No more double tape collection / achievement cheating etc.)
- Map shows correct collection stats at all times.
- Overview is disabled during Game Over
- Rain check is done with a larger radius, so thin gaps above you won't give you damage.
- Dog checks if it's about to jump through something before attacking you.
- Dog resets more robustly (possible fix for crash)
- Map selection is correctly depth sorted.
- Starting a level from the map will move you to the latest checkpoint / portal you've entered.
- Collision fixes on Gothic assets and Powerup Platform.

General fixes
- Settings changed Rumble option to a slider (for XBox One controllers)
- Settings added "Invert Y-Axis" option instead of putting it inside the layout selection.
- Settings removed some redundant control options.
- Removed text below brushes in customization menus.
- Check if Depth Buffer format is supported before creating render targets, and fall back to other versions if it isn't (largely untested)

Visuals
- Deep Button rendering fix
- Background fixed texturing of tall buildings and more.
- Chimneys now render correctly (and don't flicker any more)
- Power Up Platforms new model + texture
- Car new model + texture (WIP)
- Shop facades rendering fix
- Wires has correct ending
- Gothic Tower rendering fix
- Gothic Window rendering fix
- Windows fixed light leaking on back
- Character doesn't jerk when landing after a fast long jump
- Character doesn't jerk after being painted

Keep the feedback coming!

Have an amazing weekend!

notes.title: Beta Update March 9th
notes.content:
Hi

Another busy week is ending with a new beta release! Here's a quick overview of what's changed:

[b]60Hz Mode:[/b]
- The game defaults to 60 Hz mode, and all known issues have been fixed.
- Fixed camera in fan
- Fixed train stopping incorrectly
- Fixed vegetation painting in editor

[b]Map:[/b]
- Improved performance, so it should run smoothly for everyone.
- Rendering fixes.
- Added Cassette display when expanding a level
- Added Graffiti display (when you've collected it)
- Added Powerup display (when you've collected it)
- Adjusted Main Game map slightly

[b]Audio:[/b]
- Fixed some incorrect mixer settings (wall jump audio and more)
- Added arm swing audio
- Adjustments to danger music

[b]Levels:[/b]
- AirStreamTower - Umbrella respawn fix
- PogoJump - Fix for counters

[b]General:[/b]
- Added additional Analytics events
- Added setting for frame dropping or not (may not work 100%)
- Performance improvements
- Disabled map/overview in powerup sequence
- Disabled map/overview in outtro sequence
- Disabled map/overview while driving
- Default to 1280x720 fullscreen when starting the first time.

[b]Rendering:[/b]
- Fixed "Counter" to display number correctly
- Created actual models for Tower parts
- Improved rendering of Depth Of Field
- Improved rendering of light volumes
- Improved dithering on character transparency

Next week will be all about getting the intro sequence going, and some minor fixes to the starting flow of the game, based on all your lovely feedback!

Please let us know of any issues you encounter, and keep sending us feedback via email (support@frecle.net) or on the Beta Discussion forums here!

Have a great weekend!
